alt: 工坊的木架起火倒塌，精美花瓶和破裂粗陶一起摔碎，工匠在安全處焦急望著。
scene_prompt: A pottery workshop accident: one fallen brazier has set an entire wooden display shelf ablaze. On the SAME burning collapsing shelf, exquisitely glazed intact green ceramic vases and obviously cracked rough defective pots are all breaking and being destroyed together. An artisan safely outside reaches toward both in distress. Small controlled illustrated fire, no human injury. Show common destruction regardless of quality, not gems simply on fire.
